title: A token check that uses a slot of another module
kind: lab

  - cert: none
tags: [broken]
check:
  kind: token
  prompt: Paste the token.
  slot: log-m12-1
---

<Why>
A step must use a token slot of its own module. A slot of another module belongs to a different lesson, and two lessons sharing one slot would teach the learner to find the same token twice.
</Why>

<Idea>
Each module has its own slots.
</Idea>

<Do>
1. Find the token.
</Do>

<Done>
The check passes.
</Done>

<Question id="q-m90-s04" answer="a">
Which slots may a step use?

- Slots of its own module

  Right.

- Any slot

  Only its own module.

- Slots of the next module

  Only its own module.

- No slots

  Token checks use slots.
</Question>
